question: Which Mughal ruler was overthrown by British and sent to exile in Burma, after the revolt of 1857?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bahadur Shah II.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bahadur Shah II:-**

 
 
• He was the **Mughal ruler **who was overthrown by the **British** and sent to **exile in Burma** after the** revolt of 1857.**
 
• He was the last Mughal emperor who ruled India from **1837 to 1857.**
 
• Bahadur Shah II was a **poet and a calligrapher** and was not actively involved in politics.
 
• The British accused him of being a part of the **rebellion and exiled him to Rangoon,** Burma where he died in **1862.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shah Jahan:-**

 
 
• He​** **was a Mughal emperor who ruled** India from 1628 to 1658 **and is known for building the Taj Mahal.
 
 
 
• **Alamgir II:-**
 
 
• He** **was a Mughal emperor who ruled India from **1754 to 1759.**
 
 
 
• **Bahadur Shah I:-**
 
 
• He** **was a Mughal emperor who ruled India from **1707 to 1712. **
